explanation: Keep counts for the previous two prefixes. A nonzero final digit contributes the preceding count; a final pair from 10 through 26 contributes the count two positions earlier. The decoder uses fixed-width uint64_t intermediate counters and returns the contract’s int-sized count.
timeComplexity: O(n) fixed-width arithmetic steps for n digits.
attribution: Original repository-authored Blind75 C++ algorithm, promoted from the validated correct fixtures. Collection membership follows Crackr; no external solution service is used.
